What We Do

Services Tailored for You

Every window is unique. We visit, measure, design, sew and install — tunashughulikia kila kitu so you don't have to.

Custom Curtains

Tailor-made curtains in jacquard, velvet, linen na silk. Classic pleated, modern eyelet — chagua style yako.

Sheers

Light na elegant sheers zinazo-filter mwanga vizuri. Perfect peke yake ama layered with heavier curtains.

Blinds

Roller, Roman, Venetian na vertical blinds. Modern light control kwa offices, kitchens na bathrooms.

Rods & Rails

Quality rods, runners na rail systems. Cut to fit any window — finished in color ya choice yako.

Free Site Visits

Tunakuja kwa nyumba ama office yako, tunamesure precisely, na tunakushauri based on space, style na budget yako.

Expert Installation

Professional installation na trained tailors. Curtains zako zinaning\'inia perfect first time, every time.
